title: Demographic Pluralism: Inference-Time Modeling of Pluralistic Human Preference Distributions

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model-generated opinion distributions on sociopolitical and health survey questions to actual human survey data (GlobalOpinionQA, VITAL) across 131 countries using Jensen-Shannon Distance (JSD) to measure algorithmic monoculture and majority-default collapse.
Analyzing model alignment disparities and prediction errors across countries stratified into high-, medium-, and low-resource tiers based on World Bank, UNDP, and IMF economic data.

Reconstructing subgroup-level reference distributions from survey microdata and measuring the JSD between model predictions and actual human responses across intersections of age, gender, education, religion, and ethnicity.
